On Tue, Mar 1, 2022 at 9:22 AM Whitney Dubinsky <[contact omitted]>wrote:
It was great to touch base with you. One of the after actions of our conversations was to share some of
programming with clear and easy alignment with the private sector.
The first is the GEDI Program implemented by ANDE: USAID and the private sector will support entrepreneurs
and businesses to improve agriculture practices, provide innovative skills and e-commerce training and improve
business practices. USAID will also facilitate direct access to finance and other support for small and growing
businesses through incubators, accelerators, and private financial institutions, and will promote and strengthen
local and international investment in support of Guatemalan businesses. Currently the initiative has 17 private
sector partners and open to partnering with more!
The second is our new approach to mitigating irregular migration through an award with International Organization
for Migration: USAID and IOM are committed to working in close partnership with a variety of civil society
organizations, including community-based and indigenous organizations and groups to address the root causes of
irregular migration. The award is financing these organizations through calls for proposals that contribute to
reducing irregular migration by connecting Guatemalans to opportunities to achieve prosperous, secure and
dignified lives. The recent call for proposals is attached and USAID would love to have additional resources to
award.
